1.title: 6 Takeaways From Arizona’s Tense, Trump-Dominated Primaries
1.summary: Republicans nominated a former N.F.L. kicker in a top House battleground, a Trump loyalist for governor and an election denier for the state’s top election post.

2.title: At a Utah Campus, an Emotional Odyssey After Charlie Kirk’s Death
2.summary: Since Mr. Kirk was gunned down at Utah Valley University, the school and its students have struggled to find a way forward.

3.title: Government Overhauls Teen Pregnancy Program to Focus on Marriage and Starting Families
3.summary: The administration canceled federal grants to organizations across the country, accusing them of encouraging premarital sex. New criteria say programs should stress abstinence.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Rubio Signals No Letup in U.S. Strikes
4.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the United States would continue attacking Iran as long as it tried to control the Strait of Hormuz, and suggested that Tehran was “not serious” about diplomacy.

5.title: Firing of Ukraine’s Top General Signals the End of an Era
5.summary: Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi, who commanded crucial battles, oversaw an expansion of drone warfare against Russia, but many Ukrainians want even more.

6.title: Modelling scout linked to Epstein found dead in Paris suburbs
6.summary: Daniel Siad, whose name appears in the Epstein files thousands of times, had previously denied knowledge of the threat Jeffrey Epstein posed.
